title: Usage Velocity Risk Decision Workbook
content:
Purpose: Quick‑reference scoring workbook that maps short-term usage velocity shifts to risk tiers and first‑touch CSM play actions. Designed as a living spreadsheet substitute for quick internal reviews and for exporting to dashboards and automation rules.

Background / rationale:
- We see a common pattern where absolute usage counts are noisy; velocity (week-over-week change, decay-corrected) gives earlier signal for churn or expansion opportunity.
- This workbook tries to combine event velocity, feature breadth, and corrective signals (support tickets + evaluation regressions) into an interpretable risk score (0–100).
- Goal: actionable tiers (green/yellow/red) with mapped playbook steps and automation triggers.

High-level model summary:
- Signals included (raw):
  * Weekly active API keys (unique keys with >=1 request)
  * Total tokens/week per account (normalized by seat/baseline)
  * Top-3 feature usage flags (chat, embeddings, reranking) — binary per week
  * Support ticket volume (created this week) and avg. severity (1–5)
  * Eval-run regressions flagged against baseline prompts (counts)
  * Billing/payment exceptions (1/0)
  * Customer-initiated product-checkins (meetings logged)

- Derived velocity signals:
  * WAU_delta_pct = (WAU_this_week - WAU_prev_week) / max(WAU_prev_week, 1) -> clipped at -100%..+200%
  * Tokens_delta_pct = similar for tokens/week
  * Feature_drop_index = number of previously-used features with zero usage this week (0..3)

Scoring logic (candidate weights for review):
- Base score = 50 (neutral)
- WAU_delta_pct impact: weight = -0.4 * WAU_delta_pct (so a -25% WAU -> +10 risk adjustment)
- Tokens_delta_pct impact: weight = -0.2 * Tokens_delta_pct
- Feature_drop_index: +6 points per dropped feature
- New support tickets: +3 points per low-sev ticket (severity<=2), +7 per med (3), +12 per high (4-5)
- Eval regressions: +8 points per regression run flagged
- Billing exception: +20 points if present
- Recent product checkins (>=1 in last 2 weeks): -10 points (protects against false positives)

Normalization and bounds:
- After applying adjustments, clamp score to [0,100].
- Convert to tier buckets: 0–29 GREEN, 30–54 YELLOW, 55–74 ORANGE, 75–100 RED.
- Rationale for ORANGE split: we want an intermediate escalation band where senior CSM or AM outreach is recommended but not immediate legal/finance escalation.

Example walkthrough (synthetic account A):
- WAU_prev_week=120, WAU_this_week=90 -> WAU_delta_pct = -25% -> WAU impact = +10
- Tokens_delta_pct = -30% -> impact = +6
- Feature_drop_index = 1 -> +6
- 2 medium severity tickets this week -> +14
- No eval regressions, no billing exceptions, 0 product checkins -> total adjustments = +36
- Base 50 +36 = 86 -> clamp -> 86 -> RED -> immediate outreach + 48h follow-up cadence + renewal risk flagged in CRM.

Playbook mapping by tier (action templates + owner):
- GREEN (0–29): Weekly automated pulse email only. CSM: monitor. Auto-label: "stable".
- YELLOW (30–54): CSM to send targeted usage tips + ask for quick sync if >2 weeks without meeting. Auto task: 7‑day reminder.
- ORANGE (55–74): Senior CSM / AM outreach with adoption review; propose enablement session, consider trialing batching/cache suggestions (Optimize team). Auto: create opportunity check and review billing.
- RED (75–100): Immediate phone outreach within 24 hours, escalation to AE/AM if >50k ARR, open renewal-readiness playbook; consider temporary discount/contract adjustments only after health reasons documented.

Automation rules (for product infra/automation team):
- If score increases by >20 pts in a single week, create a CS-incident ticket and assign to on‑call CSM.
- If billing_exception==1 -> create finance alert AND set score >=75 regardless of other signals (manual review allowed).
- If product_checkins>=1 in last 14d -> subtract protection of 10 pts (prevents noisy escalations).

Fields to be included in the exported sheet (column list):
- account_id, account_name, reporting_week_start, WAU_this_week, WAU_prev_week, WAU_delta_pct, tokens_this_week, tokens_prev_week, tokens_delta_pct, feature_flags_used (comma-list), feature_drop_index, support_tickets_count, support_tickets_sev_sum, eval_regressions_count, billing_exception, product_checkins_14d, raw_score, final_score, tier, last_action, action_owner, notes

Open questions / outstanding items (for review at next CS sync):
- Should we use 3-week exponential smoothing for WAU to reduce noise from short campaigns? (PRO: fewer false positives; CON: slower to detect declines)
- Are weights above too aggressive for support tickets — do we want to tie severity mapping to ticket resolution time rather than severity label?
- Do we want to include NPS or CSAT signals (we have sparse data; may bias smaller accounts)?
- Should feature_drop_index be adjusted by which feature dropped (embedding loss vs misc event)? Proposed: treat loss of embeddings or chat as higher weight than telemetry-only flags.

Operational notes / runbook snippets:
- Weekly batch job will compute the sheet CSV by 03:15 UTC Monday using event pipeline namespace cs_weekly_summary.
- Required data contracts: unique_api_key_owner mapping, seat_count, baseline_tokens_per_seat. If missing, default normalizer uses historical median.
- Edge-case: newly onboarded accounts (<21 days) should be marked "onboarding" and excluded from automated escalation; they receive a separate onboarding healthcheck.

Collab checklist (who to pull in):
- Product analytics: validate WAU and tokens event definitions (Miguel)
- Support leads: alignment on ticket severity mapping and automated severity escalation (Evelyn)
- Billing/Finance: confirm billing_exception signal and required fields (Jordan)
- Platform/Infra: ensure export job has idempotent updates and soft-fail alerts (ENG-SRE)

Next steps (actionable):
1) Review weights and ORANGE tier thresholds with CS leadership — due 2024-11-20 (owner: Priya).
2) Validate event schema and set up weekly export to /s3/cs-health-workbench/usage-velocity.csv (owner: Miguel).
3) Wire automation rules into CRM (create mapping doc + sample webhook) — prototype by end of Q1 (owner: Jordan).
4) Add NPS as optional column for A/B testing of score lift detection (owner: Product Analytics).

Notes to self: keep a very small manual-override column in sheet so CSMs can note extenuating circumstances (major legal review, contract renegotiation in-flight, seasonal usage pattern).

References and helpful links:
- Confluence: Health Model Registry (linked above) — canonical place for final weights and model lineage.
- Jira: CS-482 (automation rule prototype ticket)
- Slack thread: #cs-risk-alerts (search: "velocity workbook")

Version history (track as simple audit):
- 2024-11-12 Priya: initial draft and weight proposal
- 2024-12-05 Miguel: updated event definitions and smoothing notes
- 2025-01-08 Priya: revised tiers and added ORANGE bucket; flagged action owners

Todo (short list):
- [ ] Add example CSV export row for three real customers (anonymized).
- [ ] Finalize smoothing option and run backtest on last 6 months.
- [ ] Create a short one-pager for CSMs that explains why velocity matters vs absolute usage.

End of workbook (working doc).
